## Frequently Asked Questions

How do I create an account?

You can create an account using this link: [Account Registration](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/authentication/register)

I forgot my password. How can I reset it?

1.  Click on "Forgot password"
2.  Type in the email associated with your account
3.  Click "Submit"
4.  If you have an existing account, you’ll receive a reset link. Check spam or junk if you don’t see it.

Do I need to create an account to access the Academy?

Yes, you need to create an account and log in to access the platform.

What can I access if I create an account on Optimizely Academy?

By creating an account, you can access:

*   [eLearning collections](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/catalog/list?category_ids=41482-elearning)
*   [Upcoming Events](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/all_events)
*   [Recordings of past sessions](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/collection/2621565-event-recordings)
*   and many more...

Can I register with my personal email or do I need to use my work email?

You should use your work email as your primary email and your personal email as a backup.

How can I update my email or profile details?

1.  Click your profile icon in the top-right corner
2.  Select “Settings”
3.  Update your details (name, email, company, job title, etc.)
4.  Scroll down and click “Save”

Where can I find a longer list of FAQs?

[Click here](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/page/2757102-faqs?navlink=true) for the full list of FAQs.
